description: Project discovery, preparation and native Windows/WSL development control
pre_install: & pwsh -NoProfile -File "$dir\scripts\scoop.ps1" -Action check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dev-tools check failed" }

installer.script: & pwsh -NoProfile -File "$dir\scripts\scoop.ps1" -Action install; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dev-tools install failed" }

pre_uninstall: & pwsh -NoProfile -File "$dir\scripts\scoop.ps1" -Action check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dev-tools check failed" }

uninstaller.script: & pwsh -NoProfile -File "$dir\scripts\scoop.ps1" -Action uninstall; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dev-tools uninstall failed" }
